answer: Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the plume re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
